name: 7.0 L pushrod V8, dry sump
notes: A 7.0 L small-block-sized pushrod V8 with titanium intake valves and a dry sump: 104.8 x 101.6 mm (7011 cc), 11:1, 7000 rpm (the LS7 kind: 377 kW at 6300 rpm, 637 N m at 4800; gmauthority.com). In a light front-engined sports car, six-speed manual. Its cam: the LS7's (GM 12638426: 211/230 deg at 0.050 in, 0.593/0.588 in lift on 1.8 rockers, 121 deg lobe separation; from search snippets of Chevrolet Performance's listing, the page itself refused and not read); the seats 26 deg a side beyond the 0.050 in figure and the intake centreline 112 JUDGEMENT. Its head's port quality 1.44 / 1.68 from the LS7 head's flow sheet (RLD Performance's bench, 28 in H2O: measured, third party), balanced from 0.300 to 0.600 in lift; the model's port limit over-reads that head by up to 7.5 % at 0.400 in. Its exhaust: short tubular headers, the primaries 1.00 times the layout's length: the class the real engine carries (recalled), its length JUDGEMENT. Its cams' second duration: its card's advertised and 0.050 in durations are tappet lift: through its 1.8 rocker (the LS7's 1.8, search snippets of Chevrolet Performance's listing, the page not read) to the valve, solved in the simulator's lift curve (section 8 of the judgement sources).
